summary.en-US: Adds buttons to Google Calendar event locations to open in Google Maps or copy the address.

description.en-US:
Google Calendar's event popup shows the location as plain text that opens a sidebar when clicked. This add-on adds two small buttons next to it:

- ↗️ opens the location in Google Maps in a new tab. If the location is itself a link, it opens that link directly.
- 📋 copies the location to the clipboard.

It runs only on calendar.google.com, collects no data and makes no network requests.

Source code: https://github.com/ubershmekel/google-calendar-location-link-fixer
